name: mcp-supertoinette
description: MCP server for Supertoinette. Read French recipes and rescale their quantities. No API key required.
long_description: Read recipes from Supertoinette, a French recipe site running since 2002, in an MCP client. Search by dish or ingredient, read a recipe with its ingredients, steps, times, difficulty and cost, browse the categories, and look up the wines the site ranks for a dish. Any recipe can be rescaled to another number of people, and every line says whether the arithmetic was exact or had to move to a quantity a kitchen can measure out. Read-only, no API key and no account.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Read one recipe: ingredients, steps, times, difficulty and cost, rescaled to a number of people on request.

id.description: The number in the recipe's address, such as '4210'. Search for a dish when you do not have one.

servings.description: Rescale the quantities to this many. Left out, they come back as the site published them. It is refused when the site's own wording carries no number to scale from.

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Find recipes by dish or ingredient, with the categories the site counts beside the results.

query.description: A dish or an ingredient to look for, in French.

limit.description: Rows to render, 20 by default. The site serves at most 39 to a page, and 'rows_published' always states what the page held.

page.description: Which page of results to read, 1 by default. 'last_page' says how far they run.

category.description: Narrow the search to one category, taken from the 'facets' of a previous answer and spelled exactly as the site spells it. Never build one by hand: the site answers a wording it does not know with a page that reads as an absence.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the categories recipes are browsed by, each with the token that opens its listing.

tools.name: browse_recipes
tools.description: Read one category's recipes page by page, with the difficulty and the total time of each.

category.description: The category to read, as a number and a name together, such as '107/recettes-desserts'. Take one from list_categories or from a recipe's tags.

limit.description: Rows to render, 20 by default. The site serves at most 30 to a page, and 'rows_published' always states what the page held.

page.description: Which page to read, 1 by default. 'last_page' says how far the listing runs.

tools.name: get_wine_pairings
tools.description: Read the five wines the site ranks for a dish, or a page of its alphabetical index of dishes.

id.description: The number in a dish's address, such as '10'. Give this or 'page'.

page.description: Read one page of the alphabetical index of dishes instead of one dish. Give this or 'id'.

tools.name: scale_ingredients
tools.description: Rescale a French ingredient list offline, marking each line as exact, rounded, or without a quantity.

ingredients.description: The lines to rescale, as the recipe wrote them.

factor.description: What to multiply the quantities by. Give this, or the two servings counts.

from_servings.description: How many the list was written for.
